blurb: Discover the art of sushi-making in this hands-on cooking class with Chef Melanie, hosted at a local taproom in Austin! Learn step by step how to create three delicious sushi rolls, starting with a perfectly seasoned sushi rice base. Then, layer fresh ingredients to build a creamy veggie roll, a classic California roll, and a bold tuna roll with fresh ahi tuna. Under Chef Melanie’s expert guidance, you’ll practice rolling techniques and experiment with toppings like spicy mayo, black sesame, and Japanese 7-pepper spice. While you perfect your sushi skills, enjoy the lively atmosphere of the taproom, where craft beer is available for purchase to pair with your handmade rolls. Whether you're looking for a unique date night, a social event with friends, or a fun new skill, this sushi-making class is the perfect way to roll, sip, and savor. Book your spot today!
